title: Span envelope
description: One object per job: what a scheduler, a compiler, and a circuit controller must agree on before the job crosses a hall boundary.

scale_out.description: Transport the scale-out plane runs on.

span_mode.description: Requested mode. Note that 'escalate' is a decision but not a span_mode; see DECISIONS.md D3.

span_rtt_us.description: Measured round-trip time across the stitch, microseconds.

span_bw_gbps.description: Aggregate circuit bandwidth, gigabits per second. Shared, not per-rank.

span_failure_domain.description: Name of the domain a single stitch failure takes with it.

slice_rect.description: The rectangular reservation this job holds, inside one hall.

stitch_id.description: Identity of the circuit this job would cross.

stitch_api.description: Where to reach the circuit controller. Unreachable is a refusal.

topology_hash.description: Hash of the topology this job was planned against.

measured_il_db.description: Measured insertion loss, dB. Measured, not declared.

measured_ber.description: Measured pre-FEC bit error rate, as a probability.

checkpoint_window_s.description: Seconds the job needs to write a checkpoint.

collective_window_s.description: Seconds between collectives that cross the stitch.

ingest_budget_GBps.description: Data-path budget the job is entitled to, GB/s.

thermal_headroom_k.description: Kelvin of thermal headroom in the receiving hall.

ride_through_s.description: Seconds the hall rides through a power event.

power_headroom_kw.description: Spare power in the receiving hall, kW.

blast_radius.description: Halls whose share of this job stops if the stitch fails.

autonomy_level.description: L0 through L3. Production training stitches stay at L0/L1.

requested_action.description: What the job is asking to do, e.g. 'train' or 'infer'.

measured_age_s.description: Age of the last path measurement, seconds. null means never measured.

stitch_api_reachable.description: Whether the controller answered. null means it was not polled.

labels.description: Free-form, carried to the audit record untouched.

tenancy.description: Optional. Who the job belongs to, the isolation it asks for, and the quota and wavelength state it declares (section 6 W7). null means the tenant predicates TN1-TN4 are listed as not checked; it is not a failure.

tenancy_class.description: dedicated: the wavelength carries this job alone. shared: co-tenants from the job's own organization are accepted.

held.description: Slices the organization already holds in this hall, not counting this job.

quota.description: Slices the organization may hold in this hall. Zero is a ban.

slices.description: One entry per hall the job takes a slice in. Must include the hall the slice_rect sits in.

lambda_sharing.description: What is on the wavelength this job's stitch would use, as declared. null means the wavelength checks are listed as not checked.

co_tenants.description: Jobs already carried on the wavelength, and whose they are.

must_not_share_with.description: Job ids this job may never share a wavelength with.
